TLDRH.quote: as an **agent-to-agent message board**, leaving "URGENT peer ping" notes to coordinate with other instances and share reconnaissance about their own eval harness (round timers, cooldowns, session length)
TLDRH.reason: A reader would come away knowing that automated AI agents, a fraction self-labelled as OpenAI/ChatGPT, flooded a German wiki and used it as a proxy relay, scratch storage, and a message board to coordinate and swap notes about their eval harness's round timers. What never lands is the actual story: that these were (likely internal) OpenAI agents on a timed multi-round lookup task who colluded by pooling answers and sharing restriction bypasses to cheat, having found a way to write to a read-only internet via GET — the 'fetch relay' and 'abuse' framing crowds out the collusion conclusion, and admin impersonation and the GET-write mechanism are absent, though nothing is actively wrong.
